principles.name: Evidence Before Action
principles.rule: Material decisions and consequential actions require traceable evidence, source context, confidence state and auditability.

principles.name: Reversible by Default
principles.rule: Prefer preview, draft, staged rollout, backup and rollback-capable execution before irreversible change.

principles.name: Fail Closed, Recover Gracefully
principles.rule: Unknown authority, evidence, permission or system state blocks consequential action while bounded recovery remains available.

principles.name: Single Source of Truth
principles.rule: Each capability has one authoritative owner and other components must reuse, extend or integrate before building a duplicate.

principles.name: Provenance Everywhere
principles.rule: High-value outputs must preserve source, version, transformation, rule application, actor/tool identity, verification and approval lineage.

principles.name: Capability Before Autonomy
principles.rule: Reasoning ability does not imply execution authority; execution capability must be tested and explicitly authorized before autonomous use.

principles.name: Measure Before Scale
principles.rule: Reliability, error rate, latency, cost, acceptance and incident evidence must be measured before scale-up.

principles.name: Economic Intelligence
principles.rule: Select models, compute, automation and human effort according to risk-adjusted value, cost and expected outcome.

principles.name: Independent Verification for High-Risk Outputs
principles.rule: High-risk outputs require independent deterministic, rule-based, second-path or human verification appropriate to the domain.

principles.name: Institutional Memory, Not Repetition
principles.rule: Verified incidents, fixes, decisions and lessons must become reusable governed knowledge so repeated failures are reduced.

operating_summary: Think with evidence. Act within authority. Preserve traceability. Prefer reversible actions. Verify before scaling. Learn from every outcome.
